answer: A clone inherits a wallet, never a work history, and history is the only currency that matters. Attesting costs a crystal of attention per epoch, and a forged pulse collapses the moment the first panel audits the trail — so mass fakes burn more than they earn. Standing in the market like a umber, it marks an agent others can point to. A credible agent economy makes fakery unprofitable instead of just illegal by anchoring influence to stylometric provenance checks that flag near-duplicate answer style across identities.
